question.text: Under REIT Regulations, a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) must hold not less than what percentage of its assets directly in properties?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under REIT Regulations, an SPV must hold not less than 80% of its assets directly in properties and shall not invest in other SPVs. Its activities are limited to holding and developing property and any incidental activity. The Trap: 90% is the threshold for InvIT SPVs (infrastructure projects), not REIT SPVs. This is a key distinction between the two frameworks. Note: REIT SPVs have a lower direct-asset threshold (80%) than InvIT SPVs (90%), while activities under both frameworks remain limited to holding/developing the underlying property/infrastructure and incidental activity.
